title.zh-TW: 固定畫面的功能步驟說明
title.en: Sticky visual with scrolling feature steps

summary.zh-TW: 產品介紹頁常見的版面：左邊的畫面固定不動，右邊的四個步驟一段段捲過；捲到哪一步，左邊就換成那一步的畫面，下方的進度條也跟著前進。往回捲方向相反。
summary.en: A common product-page layout: the visual on the left stays put while four steps scroll past on the right; whichever step is in the middle, the visual switches to match and the progress marks follow. Scrolling back reverses the direction.

text.zh-TW: 左邊的固定用 CSS 的 sticky 就好，不需要 GSAP 的 pin。GSAP 只負責「現在是哪一步、換畫面」這件事，分工比較單純。
text.en: CSS sticky handles the fixed visual — no GSAP pin needed. GSAP only decides which step is active and swaps the visual, keeping responsibilities simple.

text.zh-TW: 每一步的範圍是「它經過畫面中間的這段時間」。這段時間裡它就是目前的步驟，捲過去就換下一步。
text.en: Each step is active while it crosses the middle of the screen; scroll past and the next one takes over.

text.zh-TW: onToggle 在「進入或離開範圍」時觸發，只在進入時換畫面。往上捲、往下捲都會正確觸發，不用自己算方向。
text.en: onToggle fires on entering or leaving the range; the visual changes only on entry. It works scrolling either way without tracking direction yourself.

text.zh-TW: 往下捲時新畫面從下面浮上來、往上捲時從上面下來，方向和捲動一致，比單純淡入淡出更清楚「往前還是往後」。
text.en: New visuals rise from below when scrolling down and drop from above when scrolling up — matching the scroll makes forward and back clearer than a plain fade.
